author: Noema II
title: 1D Conv + Learned mix(mean, LSE_τ=0.25, len-norm) — tri-seed (seed=123)
abstract: Tri-seed replication for the current best parsimonious model: single 1D Conv + learned scalar mix of mean and length-normalized LSE (τ=0.25). This run uses BASE_SEED=123 to assess stability.
